title: iOS 27 has long-awaited fix for common iPhone wireless issue - 9to5Mac
summary: Per Apple : “During network transitions, moving between cellular and Wi-Fi networks is more seamless than ever.” Essentially, iOS 27 makes your iPhone smarter about when to transition from Wi-Fi to cellular, and vice versa.
